metadata.title: K-area bounds for smooth sphere bundles
metadata.abstract: Let $E\to B$ be a smooth $S^n$ bundle with oriented Riemannian total space $(E,g)$, where $n\ge2$. We prove K-area$(E,g)\le4\pi n(n-1)/\sigma$ whenever every fibre has intrinsic scalar curvature at least $\sigma>0$, independently of the dimension of $B$. In particular, unit round fibres give K-area$(E,g)\le4\pi$. For arbitrary metrics on two-sphere fibres, K-area is bounded by the supremum of their areas. We also obtain stronger bounds from fibrewise scalar spectra.

analysis.progressType: 纤维标量曲率控制的 K-area 界
analysis.workSummary: 对光滑 Sn 丛的定向黎曼总空间，在每个纤维内蕴标量曲率至少 σ>0 时证明 K-area≤4πn(n−1)/σ，与底空间维数无关；单位圆球纤维得到 4π，任意二球纤维可由最大纤维面积控制，并讨论更强的谱界。
analysis.breakthrough: 用纤维几何而非总空间维数得到总空间的定量拓扑几何控制。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。n≥2、定向性及纤维内蕴度量条件不可省略；摘要没有给出所有可能等号情形。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
